match.title: Pakistan A vs Nepal
match.league: ACC Emerging Teams Asia Cup ODI
match.h2h: Pakistan A and Nepal have met once previously in the ACC Emerging Teams Asia Cup during the 2023 group stage in Colombo, where Pakistan A won by 4 wickets. Chasing 180 after Shahnawaz Dahani took 5/38, Pakistan A reached 181/6 in 32.5 overs despite a fighting 75 from Nepal's Sompal Kami.
